steps.label: DCSync
steps.sub: impersonates a DC to request replicated password hashes

code:
Normal: DC <-> DC replication
        (password hashes included)

DCSync: attacker's host -> "I'm a DC too"
        requests replication of
        every account's password hash

Ordinary workstations never
legitimately issue this request.
caption: An anomaly Defender for Identity is positioned to catch because its sensor sits on the domain controller itself.
